title: Imani and the Lost Shape Map
credit: Original story and SVG illustrations created for Axiom Play Studios with OpenAI Codex.

scenes.narrative: Imani finds a folded map on the island shore. It opens two papery eyes. “I belong in the island library,” it says, “but the wind has muddled my trail!” Imani puts on her explorer hat. “We can look at the shapes together.” The first clue glows beside a round pool.
scenes.alt: Imani wears a teal explorer hat and golden jacket on a sandy geometric island. A smiling folded map with eyes greets her beside turquoise water.

scenes.narrative: The map points to a lagoon with one smooth edge that goes all the way around. “My first clue has no corners,” it says. Imani sees a circle reflected in the pool. Matching that shape will show which path leaves the shore.
scenes.alt: Imani and the friendly talking map at the round lagoon. A round lagoon repeats the smooth circle on the map clue. A large separate card shows circle from left to right; the completed discovery appears only after an activity path is finished.

activity.physicalPrompt: Optional: with your adult, trace a round shape in the air while seated, or point to a round shape already in view.
activity.adultHelp: Adult: read this optional invitation aloud. Stay safely seated together; no materials are needed. Point only at something already within view. Use the pictured screen activity or skip with the same story ending.

screen.label: Look at the large clue picture. Choose the same shape below, then check your answer.

scenes.narrative: A tall rock rises ahead. Two sloping sides meet at its peak, and one side lies across the ground. “Three sides!” says Imani. The map brightens. Its next clue belongs to this pointed pass, where a sheltered path crosses the hill.
scenes.alt: Imani and the friendly talking map at the triangle pass. Two sloping rock sides meet at a pointed peak above a triangular opening. A large separate card shows triangle from left to right; the completed discovery appears only after an activity path is finished.

activity.physicalPrompt: Optional: with your adult, draw a triangle in the air with one finger while seated. Count its three sides together.
activity.adultHelp: Adult: read this optional invitation aloud. Stay safely seated together; no materials are needed. Point only at something already within view. Use the pictured screen activity or skip with the same story ending.

screen.label: Look at the large clue picture. Choose the same shape below, then check your answer.

scenes.narrative: Behind the pass is a stone gate. Its clue has four straight sides, all the same length. “I nearly called that a triangle,” the map admits. “Let’s look once more.” Imani follows the four corners. The square will guide them through the old wall.
scenes.alt: Imani and the friendly talking map at the square gate. A sandy stone gate frames a square clue with four equal straight sides. A large separate card shows square from left to right; the completed discovery appears only after an activity path is finished.

activity.physicalPrompt: Optional: with your adult, trace a square in the air while seated, or point at a square shape already within view.
activity.adultHelp: Adult: read this optional invitation aloud. Stay safely seated together; no materials are needed. Point only at something already within view. Use the pictured screen activity or skip with the same story ending.

screen.label: Look at the large clue picture. Choose the same shape below, then check your answer.

scenes.narrative: The seaside path bends beneath a great stone arch. The clue has a curved top, two straight sides and a flat bottom. “A doorway shape!” says Imani. The map remembers sitting beside a library door like this. First, they must find the crossing beyond the cove.
scenes.alt: Imani and the friendly talking map at the arch cove. A lavender stone arch curves over the shore and repeats the rounded-top clue. A large separate card shows arch from left to right; the completed discovery appears only after an activity path is finished.

activity.physicalPrompt: Optional: with your adult, trace a curved doorway in the air while seated. Let your finger travel over the top and down.
activity.adultHelp: Adult: read this optional invitation aloud. Stay safely seated together; no materials are needed. Point only at something already within view. Use the pictured screen activity or skip with the same story ending.

screen.label: Look at the large clue picture. Choose the same shape below, then check your answer.

scenes.narrative: Three broad stepping stones cross a little ribbon of water. Their pictures go circle, triangle, square from left to right. “My trail remembers an order,” says the map. Imani follows the pictured row with her eyes. Copying it will lead them safely to the far bank in the story.
scenes.alt: Imani and the friendly talking map at the three stepping shapes. Three stepping stones carry a circle, triangle and square in a visible left-to-right row. A large separate card shows circle, triangle, square from left to right; the completed discovery appears only after an activity path is finished.

activity.physicalPrompt: Optional: with your adult, trace circle, triangle, square in the air while seated. You can also point at those three pictures on screen.
activity.adultHelp: Adult: read this optional invitation aloud. Stay safely seated together; no materials are needed. Point only at something already within view. Use the pictured screen activity or skip with the same story ending.

screen.label: Copy the pictured trail from left to right. Touch a shape for each picture, then check your answer.

scenes.narrative: At the far bank, four trail markers lead toward a warm coral building. Square, circle, square, circle: the same little pair repeats. “That is my homeward trail!” says the map. Imani copies the whole visible pattern. With every shape in its place, the library is just ahead.
scenes.alt: Imani and the friendly talking map at the repeating homeward trail. Four trail markers alternate a teal square and coral circle toward the library. A large separate card shows square, circle, square, circle from left to right; the completed discovery appears only after an activity path is finished.

activity.physicalPrompt: Optional: with your adult, point to square, circle, square, circle on the screen while seated. You may trace the repeating pair in the air instead.
activity.adultHelp: Adult: read this optional invitation aloud. Stay safely seated together; no materials are needed. Point only at something already within view. Use the pictured screen activity or skip with the same story ending.

screen.label: Copy the pictured trail from left to right. Touch a shape for each picture, then check your answer.

scenes.narrative: Beyond the patterned trail stands the island library. Its roof has three sides, its windows have four, and its door curves like the cove. “Home!” says the map. Imani places it on a welcoming shelf. She has not needed to carry any shapes away: looking closely has helped a lost friend find its place.
scenes.alt: Imani and the talking map reach the island library, a coral building with a triangular roof and open teal door.

prompts.question: Where did the talking map belong?
Which shape had no corners at the lagoon?
How might the map feel when it sees the library?
prompts.answer: It might feel relieved, happy or safe. Another feeling is welcome too.

prompts.question: Which shape would you put on a map of a place you like?
prompts.answer: Choose any shape and tell or show what it could mean.
